                };\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Check for localhost/private IPs to prevent SSRF (skip when allowLocalhostProxy for dev/test)\n            if (context === 'proxy') {\n                if (!this.config.allowLocalhostProxy) {\n                    const hostname = parsedUrl.hostname.toLowerCase();\n\n                    // Check for localhost\n                    if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1' || hostname === '::1') {\n                        return {\n                            valid: false,\n                            error: 'Localhost is not allowed for proxy URLs'\n                        };\n                    }\n\n                    // For private IP ranges (simplified check)\n                    if (this.isPrivateIP(hostname)) {\n                        return {\n                            valid: false,\n                            error: 'Private IP addresses are not allowed for proxy URLs'\n                        };\n                    }\n\n                    // For link-local addresses\n                    if (hostname.startsWith('169.254.') || hostname.startsWith('fe80:')) {\n }\n\n    /**\n     * Check if a hostname is a private IP address\n     */\n    private isPrivateIP(hostname: string): boolean {\n        // IPv4 private ranges\n        const privateIPv4Patterns = [\n            /^0\\./, // 0.0.0.0/8 (This network)\n            /^10\\./, // 10.0.0.0/8 (Private)\n            /^100\\.(6[4-9]|[7-9][0-9]|1[0-1][0-9]|12[0-7])\\./, // 100.64.0.0/10 (CGNAT)\n parse cache and the background pattern cache implement the\n * same LRU eviction pattern using Map's insertion-order guarantee.  This\n * tiny utility centralises that logic so it can be reused without\n * duplication.\n *\n * Usage:\n * ```ts\n * const cache = new LRUMap<string, CanvasPattern>(50);\n * const entry = cache.get(key); // promotes if found, returns undefined otherwise\n * cache.set(key, value);         // evicts oldest entry when at capacity\n * ```\n */\nexport class LRUMap<K, V> {\n    private readonly _map: Map<K, V>;\n\n    constructor(private readonly maxSize: number) {\n        this._map = new Map();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get a value by key.\n     * On cache hit the entry is promoted to the end of the Map (most-recently-used).\n     * Returns `undefined` on miss.\n     */\n    get(key: K): V | undefined {\n        if (!this._map.has(key)) {\n            return undefined;\n        }\n        // Delete-then-set promotes the entry to MRU position.\n        const value = this._map.get(key)!;\n        this._map.delete(key);\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n        return value;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert or update a key-value pair.\n     * If the key already exists it is moved to MRU position.  If the map is\n     * at capacity the least-recently-used entry (oldest insertion order) is\n     * evicted before inserting.\n     */\n    set(key: K, value: V): void {\n        if (this._map.has(key)) {\n            this._map.delete(key);\n        } else if (this._map.size >= this.maxSize) {\n            const oldestKey = this._map.keys().next().value;\n            if (oldestKey !== undefined) {\n                this._map.delete(oldestKey);\n            }\n        }\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n    }\n\n    /** Current number of entries. */\n    get size(): number {\n        return this._map.size;\n    }\n\n    /** Remove all entries. */\n    clear(): void {\n        this._map.clear();\n    }\n}\n","/**\n * Background Renderer\n *\n * Handles rendering of element backgrounds including:\n * - parse cache and the background pattern cache implement the\n * same LRU eviction pattern using Map's insertion-order guarantee.  This\n * tiny utility centralises that logic so it can be reused without\n * duplication.\n *\n * Usage:\n * ```ts\n * const cache = new LRUMap<string, CanvasPattern>(50);\n * const entry = cache.get(key); // promotes if found, returns undefined otherwise\n * cache.set(key, value);         // evicts oldest entry when at capacity\n * ```\n */\nexport class LRUMap<K, V> {\n    private readonly _map: Map<K, V>;\n\n    constructor(private readonly maxSize: number) {\n        this._map = new Map();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get a value by key.\n     * On cache hit the entry is promoted to the end of the Map (most-recently-used).\n     * Returns `undefined` on miss.\n     */\n    get(key: K): V | undefined {\n        if (!this._map.has(key)) {\n            return undefined;\n        }\n        // Delete-then-set promotes the entry to MRU position.\n        const value = this._map.get(key)!;\n        this._map.delete(key);\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n        return value;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert or update a key-value pair.\n     * If the key already exists it is moved to MRU position.  If the map is\n     * at capacity the least-recently-used entry (oldest insertion order) is\n     * evicted before inserting.\n     */\n    set(key: K, value: V): void {\n        if (this._map.has(key)) {\n            this._map.delete(key);\n        } else if (this._map.size >= this.maxSize) {\n            const oldestKey = this._map.keys().next().value;\n            if (oldestKey !== undefined) {\n                this._map.delete(oldestKey);\n            }\n        }\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n    }\n\n    /** Current number of entries. */\n    get size(): number {\n        return this._map.size;\n    }\n\n    /** Remove all entries. */\n    clear(): void {\n        this._map.clear();\n    }\n}\n","/**\n * Background Renderer\n *\n * Handles rendering of element backgrounds including:\n * - parse cache and the background pattern cache implement the\n * same LRU eviction pattern using Map's insertion-order guarantee.  This\n * tiny utility centralises that logic so it can be reused without\n * duplication.\n *\n * Usage:\n * ```ts\n * const cache = new LRUMap<string, CanvasPattern>(50);\n * const entry = cache.get(key); // promotes if found, returns undefined otherwise\n * cache.set(key, value);         // evicts oldest entry when at capacity\n * ```\n */\nexport class LRUMap<K, V> {\n    private readonly _map: Map<K, V>;\n\n    constructor(private readonly maxSize: number) {\n        this._map = new Map();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get a value by key.\n     * On cache hit the entry is promoted to the end of the Map (most-recently-used).\n     * Returns `undefined` on miss.\n     */\n    get(key: K): V | undefined {\n        if (!this._map.has(key)) {\n            return undefined;\n        }\n        // Delete-then-set promotes the entry to MRU position.\n        const value = this._map.get(key)!;\n        this._map.delete(key);\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n        return value;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert or update a key-value pair.\n     * If the key already exists it is moved to MRU position.  If the map is\n     * at capacity the least-recently-used entry (oldest insertion order) is\n     * evicted before inserting.\n     */\n    set(key: K, value: V): void {\n        if (this._map.has(key)) {\n            this._map.delete(key);\n        } else if (this._map.size >= this.maxSize) {\n            const oldestKey = this._map.keys().next().value;\n            if (oldestKey !== undefined) {\n                this._map.delete(oldestKey);\n            }\n        }\n        this._map.set(key, value);\n    }\n\n    /** Current number of entries. */\n    get size(): number {\n        return this._map.size;\n    }\n\n    /** Remove all entries. */\n    clear(): void {\n        this._map.clear();\n    }\n}\n","/**\n * Background Renderer\n *\n * Handles rendering of element backgrounds including:\n * -
